summary: Overall printed layout matches the official 2018 ENCS PDF closely; needs small form-local tweaks for Page 2 Item 45 specify text sizing and screen Schedule 1 developer wording, plus shared print fixes for comb overflow.

defects.where: Page 1, Item 8 Registered Address (lines 1-2) and Item 21 Spouse's Name
defects.what: Long address and spouse name overflow their comb boxes and render as plain text colliding directly with the comb tick marks.

defects.where: Page 1, Part III Items 28, 30, 34A, 35A, 35B and Page 2 Part V Items 44, 59
defects.what: Large or negative computed amounts exceeding 8 comb slots print blank (or clipped in Item 36) instead of fitting cleanly.

defects.where: Page 2, Part V.A Item 45 (Add: Other Taxable Non-Business/Non-Profession Income specify)
defects.what: Specify text shrinks noticeably smaller and sits pinned near the top of the cell compared with Item 57 below it.

defects.where: Page 2, bottom reference tables (Table 1 and Table 2 Tax Rates)
defects.what: Reference tax rate tables are moved out of the filed sheet into guide.html per provenance.json.

defects.where: Part VI Schedule 1 overflow section heading (forms/screen-1700-v2018.json)
defects.what: Heading shows internal key naming ('Row 4_1 is the employer in Item 4') instead of plain user-facing wording.

shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-print (owned by neon-4 on try/forms-shared-print): mask comb ticks under overflowing long names/addresses (Items 8, 21) and handle negative/large amounts exceeding 8-slot combs (Part III/V).
open_questions: Print preview window opens natively on Linux via WebKitGTK; full unclipped 1400px-wide print-p*.png pages were rendered from the running app's generated sheet.html via headless Chrome --print-to-pdf + pypdfium2 so the full page height is visible without window clipping.
